comment: Which route of a tier takes a task, given how used each route's provider is. Read by both the orchestrator core's tests and the frontend's, so the preview in Preferences can never say something the core would not do. `pressures` are percentages in route order; 1e300 stands for a provider that is refusing requests.

cases.name: the first route when it has room
a single route always takes it
the next route below the watch band
the order holds between the bands
a later route still below the protect band
the most room once every route is past protect
a tie goes to the earlier route
a refusing provider is the last resort
every provider refusing keeps the order
exactly on the watch band counts as past it
exactly on the protect band counts as past it
